Our Philosophy

Your Dog
Deserves Great
Photos.

At Doggie Designs, we believe your dog's personality is worth preserving. We take our time to connect with each pup — learning what makes them light up, what makes them curious, what makes them unmistakably them.

Based in Powell, TN on Clinton Hwy, we've built a welcoming space where dogs feel at ease and owners leave with images they'll treasure for years.

We specialize in portraits that feel real — not posed, not stiff. Just your dog, at their best.
